shell.title: {title} — mock authentication service
ask.title: Email
ask.codeTo: A six-digit code will be sent to {address}.
ask.codeAccount: A six-digit code will be sent to the address on the account, if it has a verified one.
ask.linkTo: A single-use link will be sent to {address}.
ask.linkAccount: A single-use link will be sent to the address on the account, if it has a verified one.
code.title: Your emailed code
code.resent: A new code is on its way.
code.sentTo: A six-digit code was sent to {address}. It works once, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
code.sentAccount: A six-digit code was sent to the address on the account, if it has a verified one. It works once, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
code.label: The code from the message
code.note: A new code replaces the last one. Nobody from this service will ever ask you for it.
wait.title: Check your email
wait.resent: A new link is on its way.
wait.sentTo: A sign-in link was sent to {address}. Open it in this browser — it works only here, once, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
wait.sentAccount: A sign-in link was sent to the address on the account, if it has a verified one. Open it in this browser — it works only here, once, for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
wait.note: This page checks every {seconds} seconds. A new link replaces the last one.
elsewhere.title: Signed in elsewhere
elsewhere.heading: Nothing is waiting here
elsewhere.body: If you opened the link, the sign-in has continued in the tab it opened, and you can close this one. If you did not, this sign-in has run out of time; start again from the application that sent you here.
open.title: Continue signing in
open.heading: Continue signing in
open.note: If you did not ask to sign in, close this page: nothing happens until Continue is pressed.
